claims.statement: A late sixteenth century assembly of sheets by Pompeo Leoni. The sheets themselves date from the whole of Leonardo's active life.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Individual sheet datings.
